column1: # Every call site of a world-build entry point named in ENTRY_POINTS
# THE SCOPE IS THAT LIST AND THOSE TREES, NOT "the workspace". This header
# said "every world-build call site in the workspace" until 2026-09-02, and
# it was false twice over: `build_world_from_components` was missing from
# ENTRY_POINTS (9 live sites across 5 files, one of them with no row here at
# all), and `examples/` is not scanned at all. Both are stated in
# world_build_sites.rs; state the scope, never the aspiration.
# A full build costs ~3.0 s in a debug build (80.8% of it in the
# climate+settlements stage); reading the committed seed-42 world costs
# ~15 ms. nextest is process-per-test, so every site pays in full, once
# Reasons: build-path (asserts on the build itself), artifacts (needs
# GeneratedTerrain/GeneratedClimate, which are not Serialize -- declared and
# currently UNUSED, no row carries it), identity (a seed, pin set, build
# depth or component set with no committed fixture), production (a real code
# path), unmigrated (grandfathered -- the ONLY reason that may not grow).
# Keyed by count per file, never by line number: a line-keyed row
# invalidates on any edit above it, which would redden this guard on
# unrelated commits and get it trained away.
# Generated 2026-09-02 at campaign start: 200 files, 350 sites, every one
# `unmigrated` by construction. Reclassification is a human act. The
# campaign's migrations took `unmigrated` to 334; admitting the sixth entry
# point at campaign close added 9 sites and one file, all classified on their
# merits, so `unmigrated` did not move and UNMIGRATED_CEILING stayed 334.
# THE TIDEMARK, Task 3: M2/M7/W5/I4. Each needs a LIVE build — M2 reads
# the committed ledger of a Full build (the fixture is not built to Full
# with this roster), and M7/W5/I4 need a live GeneratedTerrain and
# GeneratedClimate to re-score capacity, which the committed seed-42
# fixture does not carry. M7 builds three seeds by design (42/7/1234 —
# the ones the sea-elf confinement was measured over).
